name: ClickAssist
description: A transparent trajectory-based practice assist. Every active session is marked assisted and invalid for leaderboard or top-play submission.

show-live-console.name: Show Live Console
show-live-console.description: Open ClickAssist's diagnostic console when the game starts. Disabled by default.

write-detailed-telemetry.name: Write Detailed Telemetry
write-detailed-telemetry.description: Write local prediction diagnostics for troubleshooting. This never changes the always-visible assisted and invalid run status.

hud-position.name: HUD Position
hud-position.description: Choose where the dim ClickAssist and active tick indicator appear during assisted play.

cycle-stage.name: Cycle Assist Stage
cycle-stage.description: Cycle through the four assist stages and Stage 5 raw input.
